schema.sort_order: sources by source_id; role_results by family_id then source_role_id; claims by claim_id
schema.source_policy: First-party official programme and exchange pages only; no discovery page or search snippet is claim evidence.
schema.quote_policy: No verbatim quotation fields are used; evidence_locator identifies the official page section.

bounded_run.scope: Official Recruit, JAL, ANA, JR Kyushu and Moppy pages were checked for production routes between assets declared in the unified graph.
bounded_run.truncation: Only rows whose arithmetic and applicability are exact are executable. Unresolved provider details remain explicit production coverage gaps.

metadata.publisher_policy: Official operator pages only; search results were used solely to locate those pages.
metadata.pii_or_secret_check: No credentials, account identifiers, membership data, tokens or payment data included.

sources.title: JRキューポに交換する
sources.notes: The official ANA page states the 10,000-mile unit, processing time and first-two versus third-and-later fiscal-year tiers.

sources.title: 提携ポイントへの交換条件
sources.notes: The official common rule page defines the April-to-March cumulative tier counter shared by eligible partner exchanges.

sources.title: JRキューポ特典
sources.notes: The official JAL benefit page states both tiers and the 30,000-mile April-to-March limit.

sources.title: Ponta特典（JMB×Ponta会員限定）
sources.notes: The official JAL benefit page supplies the two current JAL-mile to Ponta tiers, exchange units, minimum and membership requirement.

sources.title: 提携ポイントとの交換について｜JRキューポ｜JR九州
sources.publisher: 九州旅客鉄道株式会社
sources.notes: The official JR Kyushu exchange table supplies both directions, ratios, units and named card/account prerequisites for the represented P0 programmes.

sources.title: ANAマイレージクラブに交換
sources.notes: The official Moppy detail page states 1,750 points to 500 ANA miles, no fee, a 1,750-point minimum and 1-to-3-day processing.

sources.title: ポイント交換
sources.notes: The official Moppy exchange directory supplies the current fee-free d-point and nanaco routes, minimums and processing windows.

sources.title: ポイント交換に手数料は必要？
sources.notes: The official help page states that exchange fees are deducted from the submitted Moppy-point amount.

sources.title: PayPayポイントに交換
sources.notes: The official Moppy detail page states a 1-to-1 rate, 550-point minimum, fee from 50 points and real-time processing.

sources.title: Pontaポイントに交換
sources.notes: The official Moppy detail page states a 1-to-1 rate, 315-point minimum, fee from 15 points and real-time processing.

sources.title: 楽天ポイントへの交換手数料変更のお知らせ
sources.notes: The official Moppy notice states a ten-percent exchange fee from 2026-04-01.

sources.title: Vポイントへの交換手数料変更のお知らせ
sources.notes: The official Moppy notice states a seven-percent exchange fee from 2026-04-01.

sources.title: WAON POINTへのポイント交換を開始しました
sources.notes: The official launch notice states the five supported exchange amounts and their two-percent fees.

sources.title: リクルートポイントからdポイントに交換する
sources.notes: The official detail page states 1 Recruit point to 1 d point, one-point minimum and increment, immediate processing and required account linkage.

sources.title: 交換できる提携ポイント・交換レート
sources.notes: The official partner directory lists both Ponta and d point as outbound Recruit Point exchange destinations.
